From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>

Subject: Follow-up: Demo commitment and next steps — Aperture Health

Hi Alex / Lisa —

Thanks again for taking the quick discovery call today. I know schedules are tight; I wanted to recap what we heard and propose a clear next step so we can keep momentum.

Recap (from today's discovery)
- Primary goal: reduce inference cost for clinical summarization pipeline while keeping sub-2s median latency for clinician-facing queries.
- Current constraints: mixed batch traffic, sensitive PHI, customer wants VPC/private deployment and SOC2 evidence.
- Key stakeholders: Alex (ops), Lisa (security), Engineering (will want a short tech deep dive).

Proposed next step
- 45-minute technical deep-dive focused on architecture & perf targets + short scope alignment with our infra engineer.
- Three candidate windows next week (all PT): Tue 4/13 11:00–11:45, Wed 4/14 10:00–10:45, Thu 4/15 14:00–14:45. Please pick one and confirm by EOD Monday 4/12 so we can lock eng time.

Two quick asks so we make the session productive:
1) Confirm which team members will join (ops / security / one engineer).
2) If the session will need hands-on access to a small sample dataset, flag that now so I can prepare our pre-bronze test plan.

I attached the mutual action plan and our short DQ response to help on security questions. If I don't hear back by Monday evening I'll do one final reach and then open your slot to another prospect — want to be respectful of both teams' calendars.

Attachments: mutual_action_plan.xlsx, Aperture_DQ_Response_v1.pdf

Thanks —
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0142
